candidate.definition_en: The state or quality of being lighthearted, cheerful, or festive.
candidate.explanation_ar: حالة من المرح والبهجة والسعادة، زي جو العيد أو الاحتفالات.

senses.definition_en: The state or quality of being lighthearted, cheerful, or festive.
senses.definition_ar: حالة من البهجة والمرح والسرور، لا سيما في الأجواء الاحتفالية.
examples: Her laughter added to the gaiety of the evening.
The festival was a scene of color and gaiety.
The gaiety of the carnival masked the underlying social tensions.
